slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: mark_icon
slots.about: a Tabler name drawn in the round mark on top (never the reference's logo)

slots.name: name
slots.about: the big line under the mark: what this start is for

slots.name: hint
slots.about: the centred line over the field

slots.name: field_label
slots.about: the field's label, also its spoken label

slots.name: valid
slots.about: true when entry (the field, trimmed) is good to keep

slots.name: error_text
slots.about: under the field after a tap on submit with an entry that is not valid; it clears as soon as the entry is

slots.name: or_word
slots.about: the short word between the two paths, set between two hairlines

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the line once the start is done; may read kept (blank after skip)

slots.name: set_draft
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: the field's text as it is typed

slots.name: submit
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps the entry when it is valid, else shows the error; the label is the filled button's words

slots.name: skip
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: the second path, done with nothing kept; the label is the second button's words

slots.name: change
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: brings the field back holding what was kept

empty.shows: the field with its label only; submit shows the error rather than keeping a blank

attention.shows: error_text under the field until the entry is valid

fallback.shows: done_line for a skipped start (kept is blank), change still brings the field back

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops shrink, swap and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the error is words under the field, and done carries a check and a line
